title: Yoshi no Cookie - Kuruppon Oven de Cookie
aliases: Yoshi no Cookie: Kuruppon Oven de Cookie
description: A Japan-only sequel to Yoshi's Cookie developed to advertise the titular ovens. Basic gameplay is retained, but this game adds a world map and more detailed graphics.
